**1. THE TICK IS A LEASE, NOT A PROCESS. (kills the class outright, no scope, no button.)**
The tick holder is a row in D1 with an expiry, not an isolate holding state. A wedged or dead isolate simply lapses; the next cron wake — watchdog, dispatcher, Orky, any of them — sees an expired lease and takes the tick. Nothing has to be evicted, restarted or redeployed, because nothing can hold the tick longer than the lease. A 7946-minute freeze becomes structurally impossible: max freeze = lease TTL. Build this first, it is the fix.
